blurb: KICKS Academy of Dance offers dance classes for children focusing on fun, self-confidence, and age-appropriate music and costumes. They provide a positive learning environment with qualified instructors and a creative syllabus. The studio includes observation windows for parents and an allergy-friendly snack area.
